text:
Elena: Quick sync — SableBank trial kickoff. Need to confirm owners for integration deliverables and blockers. Target pilot cutover: next Tue EOD. Who owns network whitelisting + test creds?
Raj: I can own test creds / API keys. Will provision sandbox keys by EOD today.
Tom: I can handle infra changes (VPC peering + SG rules). Need the SableBank CIDR and preferred AZs.
Elena: @Tom CIDR is 10.88.32.0/22 per their infra team. AZs: us-west-2a/us-west-2b.
Marie: Heads-up — we'll need a short maintenance window for routing changes if peering crosses accounts. Propose 30m window during low TPS.
Jess: Acceptance criteria from SE side: 1) embeddings match baseline within 2% on sample set, 2) end-to-end latency < 250ms p50 for standard requests, 3) audit logs forwarded to their SIEM. Who owns evals?
Raj: I'll run the embeddings eval and share results. Can @Jess provide the eval prompt set?
Jess: Uploading prompt set now to the shared folder. Also adding the test harness config.
Elena: Also need code-review + deployment owners for the connector (we have a small adapter lib). Who reviews PRs?
Tom: Ping me on PRs. My TODO: update infra.tf to create peering, add SG ingress, and output connection info.
Tom: CR note — after creating the peering I'm going to need someone from SRE to sign off on routes. @Marie you good to review once I push?
Marie: Yep, I can review the routes and the quick smoke tests.
Raj: API key deliverable: I'll create scoped keys (read-only embeddings + limited calls) and drop them in 1Password under SableBank/sandbox.
Elena: Blocker: SableBank uses mutual-TLS for connector auth on staging. Need cert exchange before we can call their endpoints. Who owns cert install?
Tom: We can automate cert install during deployment if SableBank provides a PKCS12 bundle. I can add a k8s secret step to the helm chart. Need their contact for cert rotation policy.
Jess: SE asked for a short POC success checklist (customer-facing). Draft: basic connectivity, sample queries validated, cost-estimate for monthly usage, SLA expectations documented. I'll draft and share.
Elena: Great. Let's capture owners succinctly: creds=Raj, infra/peering=Tom, route/signoff=SRE/Marie, evals=Raj+Jess, connector CRs=Tom. Any objections?
Marie: Sounds good. Add me to the runbook for rollback steps.
Raj: Keys done — I posted the 1Password path in the shared doc.
Tom: Pushed a WIP branch: feature/sablebank-peering. CI will fail until secrets are added. Please review when you get a sec. @Elena @Marie @Jess
deploy-bot: CI pipeline triggered for feature/sablebank-peering — build 842 failed on integration tests.
Jess: Noted. I'll look at the failing tests tonight and add a test case for mTLS handshake.
Elena: Action items: Raj (keys + eval results) by EOD; Tom (peering PR + helm secret) by tomorrow noon; Marie (route signoff + runbook) by tomorrow 3pm; Jess (POC checklist + tests) by tomorrow EOD.
Tom: Quick config snippet for the k8s secret I'll add to the PR:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: sablebank-mtls
stringData:
  p12: "<base64-pkcs12>"
  password: "<secret>"
```
Jess: 👍 i'll add the smoke tests for the mTLS flow.
Elena: Thanks all. If anything slips, callout early so we can shift the pilot cutover. :thumbsup:
